description: Figure 7 presents two line plots stacked vertically, both illustrating the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of entity popularity metrics. The x-axis for both plots is labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4)” and ranges from 1 to 19, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2 (i.e., 1, 3, 5, ..., 19). The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The top plot displays accuracy against “s_pop frequency,” while the bottom plot displays accuracy against “o_pop frequency.” Both plots feature two lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing “Final Accuracy” and a green dashed line with square markers representing “Initial Accuracy.” In both plots, the blue line generally trends upward, starting near 0.8 and reaching approximately 1.0, while the green line starts near 0.4, dips to a minimum around 0.3 at x=7, and then rises to approximately 0.6 by x=19. Error bars are present on all data points for both lines.
